newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore stocks seen weak on lack of good news.
newsitem.headline: Singapore stocks seen weak on lack of good news.

text.p: Weak sentiment, exacerbated by the benchmark Straits Times Industrials (STI) index's plunge to below 2,000 level overnight, would continue to dampen the Singapore stock market, dealers said on Thursday.
On Wednesday, the STI index traded to a low of 1,989.80 before ending at 1,993.49, led down by index-linked Cerebos Pacific.

Share prices of the food company plummetted 19.3 percent to a new year low of Singapore $6.45 after it posted disappointing first half earnings and warned of a tougher second half. It rebounded slightly by the close to end at S$6.75.
Most dealers said the market's downtrend appeared intact, unless proven otherwise by May non-oil domestic exports due later in the month.
"We might see some minor rebound on technicals but sentiment is still weak. Any upside will be short-lived," a dealer with a local institution said.
